prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: a pantry raid in rhythm — a tuna can cracked open, capers jar popped, dry pasta rattling into boiling water — fast and percussive. The camera follows garlic sizzling in olive oil, tomatoes bursting in, then tuna flaked into the sauce in chunks. Money shot: the pasta tossed through the rustic red sauce, capers rolling between glossy strands lifted in macro, steam backlit gold. Final beat: the bowl plated, olive oil drizzled in a final thread, fork twirling. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the can crack percussion, then the tomato burst. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
